blocks.text: Run short of energy and things shut down; run out of everything and you're eliminated.
Upkeep is paid from the energy stockpile. What can't be paid shuts down.
Eliminated: everything you own stays where it is but nobody controls it any more. Your ships stop, and your queues and research end.
Power Plants burn minerals, not energy, so they are not on the list.
Every consumer pays from the energy stockpile each moment.

When there is not enough for all, buildings on worlds are paid first, then ships and constructs, the cheapest first within each; what can't be paid goes offline, so the dearest ships and constructs go first.
Shut down, a thing pays no energy and does nothing.
Ships sit adrift, then pick up their orders again on restart; a carrier's drones keep fighting but its rearm timer pauses.
Constructs can't fire or build. Shields stay but don't regenerate.

Recovery: buildings on worlds, Mines included, are the last to lose power, and cheap ships such as harvesters hold on longest among ships and constructs, so keep them bringing in minerals - Power Plants restart as soon as there are minerals to burn, energy builds up, and things restart. Pausing mining or demolishing buildings cuts the drain.
